'''Guillermo Soberón Acevedo''' (29 December 1925 – 12 October 2020) was a Mexican politician, chemist, physician and educator. 

Soberón Acevedo was born in [[Iguala]], [[Guerrero]], in 1925. From 1973 to 1981, he was rector of the [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]] (UNAM). From 1982 to 1988, during the presidency of [[Miguel de la Madrid]], he served in the federal cabinet as [[Secretariat of Health (Mexico)|Secretary of Health]].<ref name="univ"/>

He was awarded the [[National Prize for Arts and Sciences (Mexico)|National Prize for Arts and Sciences]] in 1980<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ecultura.gob.mx/artistas_y_grupos_artisticos/pnca/indiceac/pnca_anoycampo.pdf |title=Premio Nacional de Ciencias y Artes |access-date=24 August 2024 |website=[[Consejo Nacional para la Cultura y las Artes]] |publisher=Secretariat of Public Education |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110722225045/http://www.ecultura.gob.mx/artistas_y_grupos_artisticos/pnca/indiceac/pnca_anoycampo.pdf |archive-date=22 July 2011}}</ref>
and was admitted to [[El Colegio Nacional (Mexico)|El Colegio Nacional]] in 1981.<ref>{{cite web |title=Guillermo Soberón: ciencias biológicas y de la salud |url=https://colnal.mx/integrantes/guillermo-soberon/ |publisher=El Colegio Nacional |access-date=25 August 2024}}</ref>

Soberón Acevedo died on 12 October 2020 in [[Mexico City]] at the age of 94.<ref name="univ">{{cite web |title=Fallece Guillermo Soberón, exrector de la UNAM |url=https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/fallece-guillermo-soberon-exrector-de-la-unam/ |publisher=El Universal |access-date=25 August 2024 |date=12 October 2020}}</ref>
